issues: Document is a certification-body accreditation scope (ФБУ "Тюменский ЦСМ", RA.RU.11АЖ42), not a testing-laboratory scope: it has no показатель/диапазон/единица columns, so indicator, range_from, range_to and unit are null for every row. norm_doc combines column 5 (технические регламенты/стандарты) and column 6 (документы/методы испытаний) joined with '; '. Rows A1.1 and B1.1-B1.20 correspond to numbered object rows (col. 1); each spans many pages of standard lists that were merged across the page breaks into one logical row per the task rules. tr_section is set to 'ТР ЕАЭС 047/2018' for A1.1 (from the heading 'А1. Подтверждение соответствия продукции требованиям ТР ЕАЭС 047/2018'); the B1.x rows fall under headings 'В. Добровольная сертификация продукции' / 'В1. Добровольная сертификация продукции', which are program-type headings, not ТР ТС/раздел headings, so tr_section is null for all B1.x rows. Rows B1.17-B1.20 (clothing) have short or empty document lists in column 6 as printed in the source (some cells are genuinely empty, not illegible). No rotated or illegible pages were encountered; all 35 pages (including the closing signature page) were read.
